Specify the target bitrate for the generated video. The syntax for FFmpeg's`-b:v` parameter should be used. FFmpeg may encode the video in a way that will not result in the exact video bitrate specified. Example values: `512K` for 512 kbps, `1M` for 1 Mbps.

## CLI flag

Use `--video-bitrate` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                 | Flag                      |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                   | `--video-bitrate <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                   | `--video-bitrate <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)             | `--video-bitrate <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)     | `--video-bitrate <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render) | `--video-bitrate <value>` |

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#videobitrate)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#videobitrate)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#videobitrate)
- [`stitchFramesToVideo()`](/docs/renderer/stitch-frames-to-video#videobitrate)
- [`canRenderMediaOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/can-render-media-on-web#videobitrate)
- [`getEncodableVideoCodecs()`](/docs/web-renderer/get-encodable-video-codecs#videobitrate)
- [`renderMediaOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/render-media-on-web#videobitrate)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setVideoBitrate('1M');
```
